queryLines:
SELECT 
    SpeedKmH,
    CornerRadiusM,
    TrackGrip,
    BikeMassKg,
    TrackTemperature,
    CASE 
        WHEN LOWER(TireType) = 'soft' THEN 'რბილი (Soft)'
        WHEN LOWER(TireType) = 'medium' THEN 'საშუალო (Medium)'
        WHEN LOWER(TireType) = 'hard' THEN 'მაგარი (Hard)'
        ELSE TireType
    END AS TireTypeGeo,
    LeanAngleDeg,
    TheoreticalLeanDeg,
    CentripetalAccelMs2,
    CornerType,
    TemperatureZone,
    TrackInclination,
    GripLevel
FROM getdata.calculated.MotogpTest
WHERE LeanAngleDeg >= :MinAngle;

columns.expression: SUM(CASE WHEN LeanAngleDeg > 50 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
AVG(CASE WHEN TrackTemperature > 40 THEN SpeedKmH END)
AVG(CASE WHEN TrackTemperature <= 30 THEN SpeedKmH END)

columns.description: Corner lean degree grouped into 5-degree bins
